verdict.rationale: Groq is an API-first inference service. It offers API-key auth, an OpenAI-compatible REST endpoint, a server-side TypeScript SDK, and an asynchronous Batch API, so it runs headlessly with no UI and fits unattended automation. Nothing in the pack documents CI use specifically, but the programmatic surface itself delivers headless operation. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, secrets handling), an official CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI/automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq
making it easy to configure your existing applications to run on Groq
